news.title: No. 10 Mount Olive claims 2nd sectional crown with win No. 20 No. Hunterdon in NJG3 final
news.excerpt: Mount Olive (28-1) secured its second sectional title in school history, having won their first back in 2016. They will now face Shawnee in the Group 3 final at 1 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 14.
